# A.stand v2

> A.stand v2 is a resident local broker that turns official AI coding CLIs installed on the user's machine into persistent, isolated subagents for any MCP host. It runs one desktop console (Tauri 2 Windows tray + WebView2) and one loopback HTTP daemon at http://127.0.0.1:3426, exposing exactly four MCP tools. Subagent context (often 200K+ tokens) stays isolated; the Lead Agent receives a concise 1–3K summary. Prompt Cache hit rates of 95%–99.8% are read from real upstream billing counters, never estimated. Quotas from free, bundled, and subscription CLIs can share priority queues and rotate automatically on 429/5xx/401. A.stand never edits external CLI configuration files.

- License: Apache License 2.0
- Runtime: Node.js >= 20 (Node.js >= 24.9.0 for DeepSeek Harness `dsh`)
- Repository: https://github.com/jia-cyber957/A.stand
- Default daemon: http://127.0.0.1:3426
- MCP endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:3426/mcp (Streamable HTTP, per-upstream bearer token)
- stdio fallback: `node dist/stdio-bridge.mjs --url http://127.0.0.1:3426/mcp --token <YOUR_TOKEN>`

## Install and launch

- Source daemon: `git clone https://github.com/jia-cyber957/A.stand.git && cd A.stand && npm install && npm run build && node dist/daemon.mjs`
- Portable Windows tray: `npm run package:desktop` → `dist-desktop/A.stand/a-stand.exe`
- Legacy Antigravity plugin (optional): `npm run install:antigravity`
- AI-agent executable playbook: https://github.com/jia-cyber957/A.stand/blob/main/AGENT_INSTALL.md

## Architecture

- Any MCP host (Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, WorkBuddy, VS Code, or generic MCP) connects to the resident daemon over Streamable HTTP or the stdio bridge.
- Each upstream client receives its own client slot, token, and MCP session attribution.
- The daemon binds to 127.0.0.1 only. The console API uses a separate UI token; `/api/health` is unauthenticated for supervisor probes.
- Core components: desktop console, 4-tool MCP factory, orchestrator (master switch, concurrency, queues, cooldowns, doorbell, gatekeeper, crash recovery, Git worktrees), and engine adapters.
- Engine adapters drive official CLIs in isolated profiles with ephemeral launch arguments and per-process environment variables. A.stand never edits `~/.codex/config.toml`, `~/.dsh/`, `~/.claude/`, `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/`, or similar config files.

## MCP tools (exactly four)

- `agent_relay_ask` — delegate to `oracle` or `hephaestus`; supports `slot`, `waitSec`, `worktree`, `modelId`, `resumeJobId`, `conversationId`.
- `agent_relay_poll` — wait on or inspect `jobId` / `jobIds`; `waitSec=0` plus `detail="full"` gives a non-blocking deep view.
- `agent_relay_review` — independent Oracle review of uncommitted changes, a branch diff, a commit, or a custom scope.
- `agent_relay_session` — `status`, `recover`, `ack`, `compact`, `fork`, `steer`, `interrupt`, `reset`.

## Roles and queues

- `oracle` (Chinese UI: 白泽) — strictly read-only advisor/reviewer; parallel slots are allowed.
- `hephaestus` (Chinese UI: 祝融) — workspace-write engineer; per-directory write mutex by default, optional Git worktree parallel writers on branch `astand/<jobId>`.
- `ordered` mode follows the configured priority queue exactly. `smart` mode lets the Lead choose a configured queue model by task complexity while retaining cooldowns and fallbacks.
- 429 / 5xx / 401 → automatic cooldown, failover to the next entry, and auto-restore at the upstream `resetsAt`.
- Full exhaustion returns `[ALL_ENGINES_EXHAUSTED]` plus a zero-AI, zero-network local handoff brief derived from local state only.

## Supported model providers

- Native engines: OpenAI Codex CLI (`codex app-server`), DeepSeek Harness (`dsh` / ACP), Anthropic Claude Code (`stream-json`), Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`, headless).
- Official CLI presets: OpenCode, Qoder, Qoder Global, MiniMax Code, Kimi Code, JetBrains Junie, AWS Kiro CLI, Huawei Cloud CodeArts (headless), CodeBuddy CLI, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor CLI, Doubao CLI (ACP).
- Extensible: custom ACP or headless CLI descriptors, plus OpenAI-compatible API channels (Base URL + key, `Fetch Models` via `GET /models`).
- In-app capabilities: CLI install/update with live progress, OAuth/QR sign-in, Standard vs Global region selection for CodeBuddy and MiniMax, isolated multi-account pools, model whitelist filtering, real Codex 5h/7d quota tracking, and API channel management.

## Invariants

- Lead context protection: subagent context stays inside the subagent process; only a concise final summary returns (full output persisted on disk).
- Real telemetry: cache hit rates and Codex quota windows come from genuine upstream counters; unavailable balances are labeled, never fabricated.
- Explicit session lifecycle: omit `sessionId` for a new task; pass the previous footer `sessionId` only to continue the exact same task.
- Zero mutation: A.stand does not modify external CLI configs. Official CLIs perform their own sign-in; A.stand uses isolated profiles and ephemeral arguments.
- Secrets: API keys and client tokens live in private `secrets.json` (`0600`); diagnostic bundles exclude secrets; the UI provides privacy masking.
- Sandbox split: Oracle is always read-only (native sandbox, ACP fail-closed, read-only tool allowlist, or prompt guard). Hephaestus defaults to `workspace-write`; full access and worktree parallelism are explicit opt-ins.
- Master hard switch: default OFF; when OFF, the MCP server rejects new delegation.
- Network resilience: `utf8EnvChecked` strips dead loopback proxies while preserving live proxies; `proxyFingerprint` recycles idle children after network changes.

## Host integration layers

- `plugin/rules/AGENTS.md` — always-loaded delegation gate: context protection, Claude Code + OMO boundaries, visual-spec handoff, clean `sessionId` discipline, no substitute subagents, browser restraint.
- `plugin/skills/agent-relay/SKILL.md` — on-demand orchestration playbook: parallel Oracle slots, zero-token async doorbell `wait-job.mjs`, Git worktree writers, crash recovery.
- In-app “Skills & Extensions” (技能与扩展) — assign local `SKILL.md` files/folders, prompt templates, and non-secret subagent MCP metadata independently per role (`oracle`, `hephaestus`, or both), compiled once on Turn 1 (`≤ 2000` chars/item, `≤ 6000` chars/role, auto-fallback to on-demand path index) to protect Prompt Cache; ships with 2 optional built-in guardrails.
